text:
#!name=哔哩哔哩去广告
#!desc=哔哩哔哩去广告 · 来源 重写库
#!author=ddgksf2013

[MITM]
hostname = app.bilibili.com, api.live.bilibili.com, api.vc.bilibili.com, api.bilibili.com, manga.bilibili.com, grpc.biliapi.net, api.biliapi.net, -broadcast.chat.bilibili.com, -*cdn*.biliapi.net, -*tracker*.biliapi.net

[Rewrite]
^https?:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/x\/resource\/ip - reject
^https?:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/bilibili\.app\.interface\.v1\.Search\/Default - reject
^https?:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/x\/resource\/top\/activity - reject
^https://app.bilibili.com/x/v2/splash/show - reject
^https://app.bilibili.com/x/v2/search/defaultwords - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.bilibili\.com\/x\/vip\/ads\/material\/report - reject
^https://api.bilibili.com/pgc/season/player/cards - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.vc\.bilibili\.com\/search_svr\/v\d\/Search\/recommend_words - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.vc\.bilibili\.com\/topic_svr\/v1\/topic_svr - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.bilibili\.com\/pgc\/season\/app\/related\/recommend\? - reject
^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/comic\.v\d\.Comic\/(Flash|ListFlash) - reject

[Script]
http-response ^https?:\/\/i.\.hdslb\.com\/bfs\/subtitle\/.+\.json$, script-path=https://github.com/deezertidal/private/raw/master/js-backup/Rewrite/Function/Bilibili_CC.conf, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.(bilibili|biliapi)\.(com|net)\/pgc\/page\/cinema\/tab\?, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/x\/v2\/splash\/list, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/x\/resource\/show\/skin\?, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/x\/v2\/account\/myinfo\?, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https://app.bilibili.com/x/v2/search/square, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/x\/v2\/feed\/index, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.(bilibili|biliapi)\.(com|net)\/pgc\/page\/bangumi, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.live\.bilibili\.com\/xlive\/app-room\/v1\/index\/getInfoByRoom, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.vc\.bilibili\.com\/dynamic_svr\/v1\/dynamic_svr\/dynamic_(history|new)\?, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/x\/resource\/show\/tab, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/x\/v2\/account\/mine, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/bilibili_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/bilibili\.app\.(view\.v1\.View\/View|dynamic\.v2\.Dynamic\/DynAll)$, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/app2smile/rules/master/js/bilibili-proto.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https://app\.bilibili\.com/bilibili\.app\.dynamic\.v2\.Dynamic/DynAll$, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yjqiang/surge_scripts/main/scripts/bilibili/bilibili_dynamic.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
